intro: What lights me up, the things I'd do even if nobody paid me. Each one already shows in how I work. The goal is to make them show on the channel too.

passions.title: Learning by myself through video
passions.what: My university was YouTube and the internet. I learn new tech by watching, pausing, trying it, and watching again, mostly in English and mostly self-directed.
passions.proof: Two tries at university, then a career from tutoring to SRE to AI, all learned on my own.
channel: 🎬 'How I Learn Any New Tech From YouTube in a Weekend' (my real system on screen)
📚 Every video is something I just learned myself: learning in public, never lecturing from above
🏫 Skool: shared playlists and 'watch with me' sessions

passions.title: Asking questions, passionately
passions.what: I ask questions until the thing makes sense: of people, of documentation, of AI. Curiosity is the engine, and good questions are the real skill in the AI era.
passions.proof: Openness 75 and Quick Start 9: I'd rather ask and try than wait for the manual.
channel: ❓ A 'Questions I Asked This Week' series: the question, what I found, what I built
🤖 Show the actual prompts and questions you ask an AI, because asking well is the new coding
🎙️ Skool Lives built on members' questions, not slides

passions.title: Building software: solutions, implemented
passions.what: I come up with a solution and build it. 612 repositories since 2013, from small experiments to full systems like this dashboard.
passions.proof: 612 GitHub repos. This site is one of them: built, deployed and improved in public.
channel: 📦 'Repo of the Week' Shorts: the problem, the solution, the repo link
🔗 Every tutorial ships with its repo (the lead magnet for Skool)
🏗️ Show the build loop live: idea → agent → repo → deployed

loop.title: 🔁 How the passions feed each other
loop.text: Watch to learn, ask until it makes sense, then build the answer. Every repo starts as a question, and every question starts with something you watched.
